title: Food in Our Environment
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names local foods and sorts them into energy-giving, body-building and protective foods, and builds a plate with all three.

floor.prerequisite: Knows food from plants and from animals.
floor.question: Does an egg come from a plant or an animal?

representations: real foods or pictures of ugali, beans, eggs, sukuma, mango
a plate drawn in three parts
three baskets labelled with the groups
steps: Say what each group does for the body.

board.do: Draw a plate in three parts.

board.say: We have ugali and beans. What goes here?

board.do: Wait for the child to name a fruit or vegetable.

misconceptions.ask: Which group does ugali belong to?
misconceptions.repair: Say: ugali gives energy to run and play. Beans and eggs build the body. Sort a plate of ugali, beans and sukuma.

listen_for: No, protective foods are sweet fruits
misconceptions.ask: Is sukuma wiki a protective food?
misconceptions.repair: Put sukuma, cabbage, mango and orange in one basket labelled protective. Say: they help us fight disease.

listen_for: None, milk is only a drink
misconceptions.ask: Which group does milk belong to?
misconceptions.repair: Show that milk comes from a cow like meat and helps babies grow. It is a body-building food.

misconceptions.ask: Which meal is balanced? A: rice only. B: rice, beans and cabbage.
misconceptions.repair: Draw a plate in three parts. Fill each part with one group. Say: a good meal has all three.
